decisions.text: the values are not far from zero compared with their spread
each line its own colour, handed out top to bottom by the line ends: Central slot 1, East slot 2, West slot 3, South slot 4, Int'l slot 5
each line labelled at its end, in the text grey, packed in order: West moved 0.10 line heights, South moved 0.07 line heights, Int'l moved 0.03 line heights
no point markers: no value is isolated and no straight run hides one

dotted only where the values are of lower certainty: East from June 2022 to July 2022; Central from June 2022 to July 2022; Average from June 2022 to July 2022; West from June 2022 to July 2022; South from June 2022 to July 2022; Int'l from June 2022 to July 2022
a projection continues its line dotted, in its colour, from the last actual value; the label at its end
reference series in the reserved dark grey, labelled in bold: Average
highlighted, twice as thick, in the strong shade of its hue, its label bold: Central; the others keep their colours and widths
the unit phrase on the top label: “140 employees”; the top gridline starts after it
time axis: row 2 (“2022”) left out, the title gives it (G2.37)
